newsitem.title: USA: Vista 2000 delays 10Q filing, sees loss.
newsitem.headline: Vista 2000 delays 10Q filing, sees loss.

text.p: Vista 2000 Inc said on Thursday it would delay filing certain of its 1996 Form 10-Q financial reports, until it determined whether it needed to restate its December 1995 balance sheet.
The company also said it expected to report a substantial loss for 1996, because of asset sales, adjustments and inventory write-offs and other operating losses.
Vista 2000 said its auditors, Grant Thornton LLP, were currently unable to express an opinion on Vista's consolidated financial statements for the year ending December 1995.
The company said it would delay filing its Form 10-Q financial reports for the periods ending March 31, 1996, June 30, 1996 and September 30, 1996.
The earliest date for filing its 1996 Form 10-Q reports would be December 15, the company said.
Vista said it continued to engage Grant Thornton as its auditors and expected to file its 1996 Form 10-K by March 15, 1997, barring any unforeseen problems with the audit.
In May, the Nasdaq stock market delisted the company's shares because it had not filed its annual report for 1995.
The company was not immediately available to comment further.
